## 2024-10-28 - Preventing Command Injection in OS native UI script execution
**Vulnerability:** Shell/command injection when prompting user for PIV credentials natively in OS.
**Learning:** `std::process::Command::new` in Rust is safe, but passing interpolated values into an interpreted script (e.g. `powershell -EncodedCommand` generated by string formatting, or `osascript -e` where the script is generated via format) can lead to command injection if the interpolated strings (`title` or `prompt`) contain unescaped or insufficiently escaped quotes.
**Prevention:** Rather than interpolating parameters (like `prompt` and `title`) into the script text itself, pass the values via environment variables and read them out natively in the script using environment functions (e.g., `[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable()` in Powershell, `system attribute` in AppleScript).
